description: Grants reach Codex as per-thread config overrides, never as writes to its config files: with MCP rules to translate, the adapter first reads the effective config (config/read for the worktree) and only configures servers Codex actually has, plus those Switchyard itself adds for this spawn (launch config). Allow tool -> tools.<tool>.approval_mode approve; allow * -> default_tools_approval_mode approve; deny tool -> disabled_tools; deny * -> enabled false. Rules for servers Codex does not have (slack) are left out; Switchyard answers those itself if asked. Command and network grants are never passed to Codex (it has no per-invocation rule for them): Switchyard answers its requests. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
